I am extremely disappointed with my recent purchase from [ANAND FURNITURE]. I ordered a wardrobe and a dressing table, but both pieces were made with subpar materials and shoddy craftsmanship.

1.	Quality Issues: The wardrobe and dressing table look nothing like what was promised. The materials used are of third-class quality, and the finishing is extremely poor.
2.	Durability Concerns: After just a few days of use, the furniture started to show signs of wear and tear. The drawers don’t slide properly, and the wardrobe doors don’t close as they should.
3.	Service and Response: When I reached out to the store to address these issues, their customer service was unhelpful and dismissive. Despite multiple attempts to get the problems fixed, no action has been taken.

I would strongly advise others to avoid this shop. The experience has been a waste of time and money, and I regret making the purchase.

**Terrible Service and Cheap Quality – Avoid This Place!**

I purchased a temple for ₹45,000 from this shop, and the experience has been nothing but a disaster. The owner, Siddhi, is completely irresponsible, offering zero customer support. The materials used are low-quality, likely cheap Chinese products disguised as something better. Within just six months, all the PVC parts started peeling off, and the LED lights fused. The salesman, Santosh, is even worse. He is lazy, rude, and has no sense of customer service. He promised repairs but took months to act, and then had the nerve to ask for travel allowances on top of everything. This shop is a joke with no professionalism or quality. Definitely *not recommended*. Save your time and money and go elsewhere!

• Ticket Manipulation: The only way to contact them is the app, but they keep cancelling/closing my service requests without any resolution. They simply cancel the ticket to avoid accountability.

• Lack of Access: There is absolutely no way to contact them easily. They have built a system specifically to hide from customers once they have collected the money.

• Unprofessional Staff: On the rare occasion I managed to connect with a representative, they were incredibly rude, arrogant, and dismissive of the fact that their product is causing harm. A Furlenco representative named Abrar finally came to inspect the product, but instead of fixing it, he damaged one of the chairs even further. He has become completely inaccessible and is ignoring all follow-ups.

Summary: Furlenco is happy to take your monthly rent but provides zero support when they deliver faulty, dangerous goods. I am now escalating this to the National Consumer Helpline.
